summary: First-pass end-to-end testing of La Bibliothèque Secrète (FastAPI + React). Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass, including SSE streaming from Claude Sonnet 5 via emergentintegrations. Frontend: all 7 signature flows work — home, universe browsing, story detail, timeline (22 items sorted), map (22 pins with side-panel populating on click), Quelque chose d'étrange (refresh yields new story), Vrai ou légende quiz (4 options, reveals result, next), favorites, navbar. All data-testid selectors are correctly wired.

issues: Background is a decorative photo of a South-America paper map while pins use a world equirectangular projection, so pins are placed correctly geographically but do not align with the visible printed continents/labels underneath. Consider either a plain dark background, a real world outline SVG, or a photo of a world map.

action_items: Optional: replace /carte background image with a genuine world-map outline so pin positions match the visible geography.
Optional: increase base font size / letter spacing of the copper 'overline' labels — very small on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py exposes ObjectId-free data (in-memory STORIES) — good. MongoDB is imported but never used; consider removing unused motor client or wire it up to something.
GET /api/stories/quiz returns unfiltered status; if a run picks 3 stories with the same status, the quiz still works but is less pedagogical. Consider ensuring status diversity in the pool.
SSE endpoint has no CORS-specific handling but works because global CORS middleware is permissive; fine for MVP.
Route ordering is correct: /stories/random, /stories/timeline, /stories/map, /stories/quiz are declared before /stories/{story_id} — no path collision.
Frontend FavoritesPage refetches full stories list on every ids change; small dataset so acceptable, but could just use context-provided cached list.
seed_data_creation: None — app ships with 22 seeded stories in stories_data.py
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (13 tests including SSE). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is used for all requests. Timeline & map items load asynchronously — always wait_for_selector on the item testids, not just the page testid, before counting. Favorites are localStorage-based via FavoritesContext; toggling twice cancels itself.
